ela.mp3: I moved out here when I stopped working. The winter is not as cold as people say, but the summer is not as quiet either, with the tourists. My old friends are four hours away. That is the price, and I pay it.
ele.mp3: I was away for five years. The jobs there are not as good, everybody said, and maybe that is true. I see my father every day now. Nobody understood why I came back. Nobody asked me either.
lab.mp3: One thousand six hundred and twelve people, six months, two days a week at home. Before the test, the managers predicted the work would get worse. Afterwards they said it got slightly better. And a third fewer people left the company.
voz1.mp3: The rent here is half as expensive as the old place. Half. But the internet is not as fast, and some weeks that costs me more than the money I saved.
